message.content: {"note_claim": "Searches of official and news sources show no confirmation of a claimed Jan 2026 deployment of dozens of US F-22 and F-16 jets to Greenland.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "The U.S. has about 200 troops in Greenland who are tasked with supporting an early warning ballistic missile defense mission.", "reason": "The Jan 18, 2026 article covers only airfield upgrades and a small US presence at Pituffik, with no mention of a dozens-of-jets deployment, which is consistent with the note but does not directly state that no such deployment occurred."}

parsed.note_claim: Searches of official and news sources show no confirmation of a claimed Jan 2026 deployment of dozens of US F-22 and F-16 jets to Greenland.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The U.S. has about 200 troops in Greenland who are tasked with supporting an early warning ballistic missile defense mission.
parsed.reason: The Jan 18, 2026 article covers only airfield upgrades and a small US presence at Pituffik, with no mention of a dozens-of-jets deployment, which is consistent with the note but does not directly state that no such deployment occurred.
